description: The models of a Looker, Power BI or Tableau connection whose name or group holds any word of query or its singular, in any case, at most 50: Looker explores grouped by LookML model, Power BI semantic models by workspace, Tableau published data sources by project, read with the user's access to the connection (on Tableau, their own Tableau user). A model is what the slides agent queries in its BI tool for the data a slide needs, where a dashboard tab comes in as a picture. Confirm the model with the user, then add it to a report with addReportDatasheets by its modelId and pass the new datasheet's id to sendReportMessage. listConnections gives the connection's type and id.

params.description: The ids of what the tool acts on

id.description: Unique identifier for the connection, from `listConnections`, which also returns its `type`.

type.description: The type of connection, as `type` in `listConnections`. Only Looker, Power BI (`PowerBI`) and Tableau connections have models: Looker explores, Power BI semantic models and Tableau published data sources.

query.description: Options for the call, such as filters, paging or how long to wait

Words to search for in names, separated by spaces: a dashboard, table, model or spreadsheet is returned when its name contains any of them, case-insensitively, a table's full name with its database and schema. If omitted, results aren't filtered by name. At most 50 results are returned either way.

name: searchModels
title: Search models
